blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, Philippines —A warrant of arrest has been issued against a municipal mayor and eight others over an alleged assassination attempt against a vice mayor in Maguindanao del Sur. A court in Iligan City has issued arrest warrants against Mayor Datu Rhenz Tukuran of Nabalawag in the Special Geographic Area of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) over an alleged plot to kill Vice Mayor Mohammad Omar Samama of Datu Piang, Maguindanao del Sur, province.
